summary: Oriental Rise Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval and board authorization of a reverse share split. The split ratio is set at 1-for-4, with a permissible range of 1-for-2 to 1-for-100. The reverse split applies to both issued and unissued ordinary shares; fractional shares will be rounded up. No specific market effective date or price per share is provided. The move is likely intended to meet listing standards. There are no advisors, premiums, or deal terms disclosed. Watch for the effective date announcement and potential NASDAQ compliance updates.
